title: Troopers identify 2 victims from deadly weekend crashes
text:
A string of crashes over Memorial Day weekend on Utah roads left two people dead.
A man was killed after a rollover crash in Tooele County on May 23, that landed the vehicle in a retention pond off I-80. SALT LAKE CITY — Troopers responded to multiple crashes on Saturday that resulted in fatalities between West Valley City and Tooele County.
The first happened about 12:50 p.m., when a motorcycle and an SUV collided on eastbound state Route 201 near 3000 West in West Valley City, according to Utah Highway Patrol Cpl. Jared Heywood. The motorcyclist, identified by troopers on Wednesday as Jay Reupena Pitone, 60, of Magna, was "thrown from the vehicle" after he hit the concrete retaining wall.
A motorcyclist was killed after colliding with an SUV near state Route 201 near 3000 West in West Valley on May 23. Later that evening, just after 7 p.m., troopers said a man traveling at a high rate of speed lost control of his vehicle exiting I-80, near Lake Point in Tooele County, and crashed and rolled into a retention pond.
The driver, identified Wednesday by the Utah Department of Public Safety as Jose Angel Chavez, 35, of Tooele, was airlifted to a hospital, where he later died. A man was killed after a rollover crash in Tooele County on May 23, that landed the vehicle in a retention pond off I-80.
